response.overview: Hazim is traumatized because he did not get to see his mother in time. He blames himself for disappointing Halimah. When facing Halimah's body, Khaidir suddenly pulls Hazim back just as Hazim wants to kiss his mother. At that moment, Khaidir tells him that Halimah is not his biological mother. Having a handsome face causes Hazim to be accompanied by many girls. However, everything changes when one morning, Hazim wakes up from sleep and realizes his face is covered with red spots and itching. Malik invites Hazim to get closer to the mosque and not waste time moping at home. The first time stepping foot into the mosque, after almost a year of not going there, brings a strange feeling to Hazim. Hearing the call to prayer, Hazim hurries to get up to pray. Unfortunately, his legs feel weak and he stumbles back down. Malik has to help him up and take him to the hospital. But Hazim asks to be brought home to the village.
response.title: Tetamu Ramadan
